messages:
Arun: Finance asked for a tighter GPU-hour forecast for Nov-Dec promos. We need a plan to hit ~20% burst capacity while keeping effective unit cost <= $0.40/GPU-hr. APAC queues are already spiking in our telemetry.

Maria: Do we know the spike shape? Short concurrent inference bursts or sustained fine-tunes?

Arun: Mostly short inference bursts from customer campaigns (~80% request-level) and intermittent scheduled fine-tunes (~20%). Expected peak windows: ~4-8h/day over ~10 days around promos.

Kevin: Current pain is bin-packing fragmentation: many small inference pods block 1-2 GPUs. Options: (A) slot-slicing (share smaller slices) or (B) soft-reserve buckets for high-priority tenants. Slot-slicing cuts fragmentation but increases runtime complexity and potential latency jitter.

Linda: We prototyped micro-pools in June; it helped fragmentation but added scheduling overhead and needs KV isolation in runtime. Also watch prewarm capacity.
messages_continue:
Maria: Propose hybrid: soft-reserve for top ~15-20% revenue tenants + aggressive backfill for everyone else. Keeps SLAs for critical customers and improves global packing.

Kevin: Ran an overnight sim. Summary: reserve 12% capacity for priority tenants + opportunistic backfill reduces user-visible throttles ~65% and raises unit cost ~7%. Adding prefix/KV caching for top tiers restores cost to baseline.

capacity-bot: weekly_forecast: baseline_gpu_hours=24000; projected_spike=+22%; suggested_reserved=2880h (12%); free_pool=21120h; util_alert=85%.

Arun: Kevin, paste sim config and key thresholds so I can share with Finance.

Kevin: Sim config snippet:
```
strategy: hybrid_soft_reserve
reserve_pct: 12
backfill_policy: opportunistic_with_eviction_budget
eviction_budget_per_day: 2%_gpu_hours
packing_algo: size-aware_best_fit_decreasing
prewarm_timeout: 120s
compaction_window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
```

Linda: Two ops flags: (1) APAC network spikes cause KV cache misses and cold starts — prewarm helps but we should consider geo-replicas for hot keys; (2) billing tags must be precise if we grant soft-reserve credits to tenants.

Arun: For geo-replication: can we replicate hot KV prefixes to APAC for top tenants, or at least failover to local cold caches to lower RTT?

Maria: Yes. Replicating top-5 tenants' KV prefixes to APAC estimated cost ~6% extra storage + sync egress. Ops impact: slightly higher SLO on write latency.

Kevin: Also recommend a daily compacting pass: run during low-util window (02-04 UTC) to co-locate single-slot pods into freed GPUs. Mechanism: identify reclaimable pods, drain + reschedule with 30s grace. This reduces long-tail fragmentation by ~10-15% in sim.

sre-bot: deploy_plan: canary_compaction -> eng-infra-canary (3 nodes) -> monitor 24h -> rollback if evictions >0.5%.

Linda: We need a tenant comms plan for potential short interruptions during compaction and an updated runbook. Ops must coordinate maintenance windows.

Arun: Action items (owners + ETA):
- Kevin: finalize sim results + cost bakeoff by EOD (1760055800)
- Maria: write cost-impact note for Finance and share top-5 tenant contact list (1760056000)
- Linda: draft compaction runbook + comms template (1760056200)
- Ops: enable prewarm for top tiers and prepare KV replica proposal for APAC (1760056400)

Kevin: I'll add a dashboard widget for fragmentation metrics (wasted_slots_pct) and hourly reclaimable_gpu_hours.

Maria: I'll loop in Pricing to validate $0.40/GPU-hr target and see if temporary promo credits are preferable to engineering reserves.

Arun: Thanks all. Reconvene after sim + cost notes. :thumbsup:
